purpose: Test whether the historical V2 loss on the immutable V1-generated paired corpus is consistent with fixed-update undertraining, and measure update/time efficiency without changing any historical selection or selecting a production representation.
paired_corpus_origin: immutable R7.5.3 paired corpus generated under frozen V1 continuation behavior

C1_V2_NO_FLOP_TOKEN.role: clean V2 representation comparison without a learned flop-token abstraction

diagnostic_classification.UNDERTRAINING_SUPPORTED: For both domains, V2@2x mean across the three frozen fit seeds is within the frozen V1@1x equivalence band on both heldout metrics, and V2@2x strictly improves over V2@1x in at least three of the four domain-metric cells.
diagnostic_classification.GAP_PERSISTS_AT_2X: At least one domain-metric cell remains outside the frozen V1@1x equivalence band at V2@2x. This does not prove V2 is intrinsically inferior; it only rejects recovery within the precommitted 2x update envelope on V1-generated targets.

wall_clock_analysis.method: Report measured seconds-per-step and total fit time. Do not retrospectively choose a different step budget to equalize wall time.

forbidden: call V1-generated targets ground truth for strategic quality
promote V2 or V1 to production from this diagnostic
add budgets or candidates after seeing outputs
change fit seeds, split seed, optimizer, learning rate, batch size or equivalence bands after outputs
interpret GAP_PERSISTS_AT_2X as proof of intrinsic architectural inferiority
